# Komorebi Kaffee

Komorebi Kaffee is a delivery-only coffee studio in Sector 70, Noida, India.

## Ordering

- Order in the [Ownly app](https://ownly.food/app/brand/BR465722) for delivery in Noida.
- For nearby, repeat, and bulk orders, message [WhatsApp](https://wa.me/919680971075) (+91 96809 71075).
- [Komorebi Kaffee on Google Maps](https://maps.app.goo.gl/MXccQfVLVaR7XgqU9)
- [Komorebi Kaffee on Instagram](https://instagram.com/komorebikaffee)

## Menu

Check the Ownly app for current prices and availability. Komorebi Kaffee brews with 100% Arabica coffee and uses no premix or instant coffee.
